name: terminal-cast
title: Terminal cast
description: A static terminal transcript rendered as text — command, check lines, and a ruled summary. Copy-pastable, no pixels. The component humanish.dev uses for its verify output.
docs: Import styles once in your global CSS: @import "../styles/humanish/terminal-cast.css";. Renders light-on-dark: place inside a dark surface (e.g. the pinned-replay dark panel, or your own). Example: <TerminalCast lines={[{ kind: "cmd", text: "$ humanish verify" }, { kind: "ok", text: "redaction passed" }, { kind: "sum", text: "16/16 passed" }]} />
